outcomes.name: The impact of the change has been identified and understood
Impacts have been assessed, validated and prioritised
Change impacts are actively managed through plans, governance and support

actions.action: S Recognise that the change is likely to affect people, processes, services, roles and ways of working.
M Begin discussions with leaders and stakeholders regarding who or what may be affected by the change.
M Identify high-level business areas, services, teams and stakeholder groups likely to experience change impacts.
M Explore stakeholder perceptions of where change may affect their roles, activities or responsibilities.
M Identify potential areas of disruption, opportunity or uncertainty associated with the change.
S Gain agreement that change impact assessment activities will be required.
M Begin raising awareness that different stakeholder groups may be affected in different ways.
S Review previous change initiatives to identify common impact themes, challenges and lessons learned.
M Identify and document the areas, services, teams, roles, processes and stakeholder groups affected by the change (Stakeholder Analysis)
M Undertake a draft structured Change Impact Assessment covering people, process, technology, information, governance and ways of working.
S Assess risks arising from identified change impacts (RAID log).
M Engage affected stakeholder groups to understand current ways of working and expected impacts.
M Assess stakeholder concerns, support requirements, perceived disruption and areas of uncertainty (Change Impact Assessment).
M Assess existing pain points, bottlenecks, duplication, workarounds and service pressures that may influence the scale of impact (Current State Process Mapping/Heat Map/Change Impact Assessment)
S Define and establish baseline measures that will enable comparison between current and future states.
M Complete a detailed change impact assessment across affected business areas, services, teams and roles.
M Assess the scale of impact using agreed criteria such as complexity, frequency, number of people affected and degree of difference from current ways of working.
M Translate significant change impacts into change risks, issues or mitigations where appropriate (RAID log).
M Review assessed impacts and associated risks, through appropriate governance routes so that decisions are informed by change impact evidence (RAID log).
S Identify dependencies that could affect impact management, including process, workforce, system, policy, operational or external dependencies (RAID log).
M Validate identified impacts with affected stakeholders and subject matter experts (Change Impact Assessment/Change Agent).
M Measure the effectiveness of change impact management activities across impacted stakeholder groups, services and business areas
S Review impact assessment findings to identify remaining high-impact areas requiring support or intervention.
S Gather stakeholder feedback regarding actual impacts experienced during implementation.
M Validate that identified impacts, mitigations and support activities remain relevant and effective
S Adjust impact management interventions using implementation experience, stakeholder feedback and operational insight.
S Assess whether anticipated impacts have occurred and whether mitigation activities achieved the desired outcome.
M Continuously review future impact-related risks, dependencies and emerging organisational pressures
S Monitor long-term impact trends, outcomes and organisational consequences of change initiatives
M Promote a culture where change impacts are proactively assessed, managed and used to inform organisational improvement
S Maintain organisation-wide insight mechanisms to identify emerging or cumulative impacts from ongoing change activity
S Benchmark change impact management performance and maturity across programmes and change initiatives.
S Capture and apply organisational learning from change impact successes, challenges and implementation experience
S Recognise and reinforce good practice in identifying, managing and mitigating change impacts
